analysis: The PR's only changes to docs/architecture/inference.md are two edits: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and a source-path reference at line 609 (GatedDelta.swift moved from MLXLLM/Models to MLXLMCommon). The supplied units (base lines 1618-2396) do not contain the changed lines, since the changed ranges are 3 and 609. I examined the surrounding text anyway and found no security-relevant behavior change in it. The change is documentation only, so it has no effect on code, keys, attestation, encryption, routing or billing. It touches no trust boundary, so TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011 and the T-041 prefix-cache posture (HMAC lookup tags, 30-minute TTL, account-scoped salt) are not affected by it. The unit text mentions the SSD prefix cache, MTP, media decode limits and tool-call streaming, but only as unchanged documentation. Remaining limits: I could not verify that the referenced path libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift exists after the move. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression. I did not see the code move itself, so no kernel behavior or dtype handling could be evaluated here.
